Hypothesis: ZNE increases ideal-
  GHZ probability at 3 AND 5
  qubits, with a SMALLER gain

  noise for ZNE to correct)

Deliverables: repro report (3q),
  3-vs-5 comparison table + plot,
  final report, presentation
